verdict.rationale: Salv documents a first-party "AI-Powered Insights" feature that adjudicates sanctions name matches and explains its reasoning inside the product, as informational suggestions only. This is a genuine in-product AI insight capability, but the evidence limits it to sanctions-screening name matches and rests on a single marketing-page mention. Missing for 10: AI insights or suggestions beyond name-match adjudication (e.g. across transaction monitoring, cases, or risk data), in-depth documentation of how the insights work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
